causal_availability_protocol.rejection_of_unproven_constants: Rejected arbitrary assumption of a fixed 60s delay across all sources.
causal_availability_protocol.uncertainty_interval_standard: Every event defines [min_delay_seconds, max_delay_seconds] reflecting real-world dissemination channel characteristics.
causal_availability_protocol.alfred_usage_rule: ALFRED provides calendar vintage dates (YYYY-MM-DD) for revision tracking, NOT intraday availability timestamps. Intraday timestamps are established strictly by primary publisher embargo/release schedules.

real_events.title: US Bureau of Labor Statistics May 2022 Consumer Price Index Release
real_events.source_agency: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), Department of Labor
real_events.alfred_vintage_caveat: ALFRED records series CPIAUCSL with vintage date 2022-06-10 (calendar date). ALFRED vintage date does NOT represent an intraday machine availability timestamp. The intraday timestamp is established by the BLS official embargo release schedule at 08:30:00 EDT (12:30:00 UTC).

availability_uncertainty_interval.empirical_basis: Empirical wire feed latency on federal data releases: news wires (Bloomberg/Reuters/Dow Jones) receive transmission line data at 08:30:00.000; public web server dissemination and scraping distribution occurs between 15s and 120s post-embargo.

economic_data.subsequent_revisions: Headline CPI-U unadjusted index is not subject to retrospective seasonal adjustment; seasonally adjusted components revised in annual January benchmark.

real_events.original_excerpt: The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U) increased 1.0 percent in May on a seasonally adjusted basis after rising 0.3 percent in April, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today. Over the last 12 months, the all items index increased 8.6 percent before seasonal adjustment.

real_events.title: Federal Reserve FOMC 75 bps Rate Increase Statement
real_events.alfred_vintage_caveat: Federal funds target range series DFEDTARMD has vintage date 2022-06-15. Intraday statement released at exactly 14:00:00 EDT (18:00:00 UTC).

availability_uncertainty_interval.empirical_basis: Federal Reserve website release push and press lockup release occur at 14:00:00 EDT. Wire dissemination occurs within 10 seconds; public web cache propagation takes up to 90 seconds.

economic_data.subsequent_revisions: FOMC policy statements are immutable primary historical records; no revisions applied post-release.

real_events.original_excerpt: The Committee seeks to achieve maximum employment and inflation at the rate of 2 percent over the longer run. In support of these goals, the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 1-1/2 to 1-3/4 percent and anticipates that ongoing increases in the target range will be appropriate.
